text:
Predicates:
Series(x) ::: x is a series.
British(x) ::: x is a British series.
Starring(x, y) ::: x stars y.
PilotsIn(x, y) ::: x piloted in year y.
HasWorkingTitle(x, y) ::: x has working title y.
ScriptEditor(x, y) ::: x is the script editor for y.
Premises:
Series(badults) ∧ British(badults) ∧ Starring(badults, membersOfPappys) ::: Badults is a British Sitcom series, starring members of Pappy's.
PilotsIn(badults, july2013) ::: Badults piloted in July 2013 on BBC Three.
HasWorkingTitle(badults, theSecretDudeSociety) ::: The Working title "The Secret Dude Society" was used for Badults.
ScriptEditor(andrewCollins, badults) ::: Andrew Collins was the script editor for Badults
Conclusion:
ScriptEditor(andrewCollins, badults) ∧ HasWorkingTitle(badults, theSecretDudeSociety) → ScriptEditor(andrewCollins, badults) ::: Andrew Collins was the script editor for a series with the working title "The Secret Dude Society".
